spans.s: तीवर m. 1. The ocean; 2. a hunter, a fowler; 3. name of a mixed tribe (the adulterine issue of a Rājaputrī by a Kṣatriya).
तीव्र (I) a. (f. व्रा) 1. Severe, intense, sharp, acute, violent, pungent; 2. hot, warm; 3. flashing; 4. much, excessive, endless, (op. to मंद), विलंघिताधोरणतीव्रयत्नाः R.v.48; 5. horrible, dreadful.
तीव्र (II) n. 1. Heat, pungency; 2. a shore; 3. iron, steel; 4. tin.(तीव्रम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘violently, sharply, excessively.’)
तीव्र (I) a. (f. व्रा) 1. Severe, intense, sharp, acute, violent, pungent; 2. hot, warm; 3. flashing; 4. much, excessive, endless, (op. to मंद), विलंघिताधोरणतीव्रयत्नाः R.v.48; 5. horrible, dreadful.
तीव्र-आनंद m. an epithet of Śiva.
तीव्र-संवेग a. of strong impulse or resolution.
